Sandbox_A10YL_Buildings: Abyss TYL: Roads, Buildings and Debris
Sandbox_A10YL_AgeingProfile_tooltip: Choose the overall look of the abandoned world. Realistic is the intended default. Overgrown and Extreme are scaled from the Realistic baseline so later balance changes stay consistent. Most players should leave the detailed options on Use World Ageing Style.
Sandbox_A10YL_ExistingSaveMode_tooltip: Controls what happens when A10YL is added to a save or server that may already have explored areas. New Areas Only skips chunks that Project Zomboid reports as already saved/existing where that signal is available. Age Existing Areas Too also ages existing map areas. Player-built and moved objects stay protected in all modes.
Sandbox_A10YL_VegetationIntensity_toolti: Controls grass, fallen leaves and small ground details on suitable outdoor ground. Use World Ageing Style is recommended.
Sandbox_A10YL_WoodyEncroachment_tooltip: Controls how many young trees and saplings appear on suitable natural ground. Roads, interiors, water, roofs and player-built areas stay protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_ShrubDensity_tooltip: Controls bushes and thicker vegetation on suitable ground. Higher settings make open areas feel more reclaimed.
Sandbox_A10YL_VineGrowth_tooltip: Controls vines on suitable original-world exterior walls, fences and building surfaces. Player-built buildings and fences are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_HardSurfaceEncroachment_to: Controls weeds, grass and light growth on road edges, paths, pavements and hard surfaces. Road centres remain more conservative so travel stays readable.
Sandbox_A10YL_RoadDeterioration_tooltip: Controls decorative road cracks and weathering. A10YL does not remove the underlying road surface.
Sandbox_A10YL_DebrisIntensity_tooltip: Controls decorative rubbish, loose debris and abandoned-world clutter. This does not add loot containers.
Sandbox_A10YL_HardscapeReclamation_toolt: Controls dirt, cracks and reclaiming details on pavements, car parks and other developed hard surfaces.
Sandbox_A10YL_OpeningDamage_tooltip: Controls broken windows, abandoned doors, open doors and a smaller number of missing original-world doors. Player-built and modified openings are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_HumanLegacy_tooltip: Controls remnants of old survivor activity, mainly barricade remains where building history makes them plausible.
Sandbox_A10YL_StructuralDeterioration_to: Controls safe cosmetic wall-crack overlays on suitable original-world walls. Walls are not removed or weakened.
Sandbox_A10YL_InteriorIntrusion_tooltip: Controls light plant growth and natural debris inside breached or exposed interiors. Sealed interiors and player-built structures are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_FenceDeterioration_tooltip: Controls damage and gaps in supported original-world fences. Player-built fences are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_LargeTreeFrequency_tooltip: Advanced override for larger trees and rare mature-tree infill near existing tree areas. Large trees still require suitable open ground.
Sandbox_A10YL_RoadCoreVegetation_tooltip: Advanced override for light growth in the middle of roads. Keep this lower if you want roads to stay cleaner and easier to read.
Sandbox_A10YL_RoadBreakup_tooltip: Advanced override for decorative road cracking. The road underneath is not removed or replaced.
Sandbox_A10YL_ExteriorDebris_tooltip: Advanced override for exterior rubbish and debris on suitable map-authored ground. Player-built floors and roofs are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_InteriorDebris_tooltip: Advanced override for interior debris. Building exposure and history still decide where it makes sense.
Sandbox_A10YL_WindowDamage_tooltip: Advanced override for broken original-world windows. Player-built, protected and already modified windows are left alone.
Sandbox_A10YL_DoorDamage_tooltip: Advanced override for original-world door ageing. Some doors may be open, damaged or missing depending on the building. Player-built doors are protected.
Sandbox_A10YL_BarricadeRemnants_tooltip: Advanced override for old barricade remains on suitable original-world doors and windows.
Sandbox_A10YL_RoofFailure_tooltip: Reserved internally. This option is hidden in v0.7.0 because no safe roof-failure system is active.
Sandbox_A10YL_InteriorWoodyGrowth_toolti: Advanced override for shrubs and woody growth inside breached or heavily exposed interiors.
Sandbox_A10YL_ProcessingMode_tooltip: Controls how hard the server works while ageing newly loaded areas. Balanced is the intended default. Conservative is slower and safer for weaker servers. Fast catches up quicker but uses more CPU. Background Only is the smoothest/slowest option for weak CPUs or busy hosted servers. Custom uses the detailed limits below. This does not change the final look of the world.
Sandbox_A10YL_CustomPlansPerTick_tooltip: Only used when Processing Speed is Custom. Higher values prepare more squares each tick but can increase CPU load. Range: 1-4.
Sandbox_A10YL_CustomMutationsPerTick_too: Only used when Processing Speed is Custom. Higher values apply more persistent world changes each tick but can increase CPU and network load. Range: 1-16.
Sandbox_A10YL_CustomTimeBudgetMs_tooltip: Only used when Processing Speed is Custom. Higher values finish faster but can increase stutter. Range: 0.5-6.0 ms.
Sandbox_A10YL_DebugMode_tooltip: Writes extra A10YL setup and progress information to the server log. Leave this off for normal play unless you are testing or reporting a bug.
